meta.name: Dividend Low-Vol OCF Enhanced ETF Candidate V5.7
meta.objective: Build an ETF-like enhanced basket from approved stable cash-flow sectors using operating cash-flow yield, low volatility, drawdown control and dividend support.

universe.name: PIT candidate pool from bank, utilities/electricity, highway infrastructure and port/rail infrastructure sleeves
universe.construction: Each sleeve must pass its own PIT universe, data availability and local simulation gate before entering the official V5.7 basket.

data.vendor: JoinQuant/DataJQ PIT panels, reviewed sector evidence where available, and JoinQuant real daily open/close execution prices
data.cash_dividend_policy: real cash dividends from JoinQuant STK_XR_XD, net_cash_per_share after 20% tax

signals.core_hypothesis: Across stable cash-flow and high-dividend sectors, operating cash-flow yield identifies durable cash-generation value while volatility and drawdown filters reduce value-trap and regime-risk exposure. Dividend yield supports shareholder-return discipline, but historical return alone cannot validate the basket.

research_only_factors.name: free_cash_flow_yield
research_only_factors.reason: Requires sector-specific capex quality and PIT coverage gate before promotion.

research_only_factors.name: low_price_to_book
research_only_factors.reason: Current basket evidence does not support it as a cross-sector core factor.

defensive_rule.reason: V5.7 tests ETF-like cross-sectional allocation; market timing defense is a later research layer.

individual_stop_loss_take_profit.reason: Fixed exits are not part of the current research hypothesis.

validation.acceptance_rule: PM cannot accept the ETF candidate from 2021-2026 platform-confirmation returns alone. Promotion requires stable evidence, clean data gates, platform attribution and paper trading.
